global.budgets: baseline forest store count and each evaluated supported total; report other requested budgets only with feasible upper/lower bound or unavailable
global.certification: complete exact curves for every partition required; otherwise feasible candidates only and no global lower bound
global.curve_selection: DP complete preferred, ENUM complete fallback; known feasible heuristic points only where exact incomplete

limits_rationale: Declared fixed guards for candidate/state memory and runtime. Work counts include candidates and preprocessing. No target exact coverage fraction; every case attempted; unsolved rows excluded from exact gaps.

real.class_compression: drop zero-weight or inactive local classes; merge identical positive-topic incidence and sum rational weights; preserve membership/raw counts
real.exact_domain: all materialized counts through positive_nodes, independent of comparison budget
real.random_basket_population: sorted ranked symbol paths; same as P1
real.volume_basis: full observed source record_bytes, incomplete source retained

reporting.gaps: exact solved only, same case and requested budget/objective
reporting.memory: solver state/work counts plus process max RSS; states are not allocated-byte claims
reporting.outcomes: retain timeout/state_limit/representation_limit/heuristic-only/error outcomes; never substitute incumbents for OPT
reporting.runtime: steady solver wall seconds excluding prepare and independent reconstructed evaluation; diagnostic nonexclusive host

scope: approved v1.1 Tier B L2/L3/L4/L5; modeled record bytes, no physical disk I/O

synthetic.exact_domain: counts through requested capped budget; partial curves never global certified
